summary: No monolithic current Worker Fabric or dedicated provider-adapter/collector/evaluator/integrator/challenger subsystem was verified in current main. The reusable current descendant is the universal cognitive worker kernel plus role-fluid allocator and durable claim/run/return lifecycle. Historical/stale paths are source debt, not current implementation evidence. Route change: preserve and harden the current behavioral contracts; do not create a second Worker Fabric runtime or duplicate opportunity unless exact historical bytes later prove a missing behavior.

route_change.before: Historical Worker Fabric vocabulary could be interpreted as a missing subsystem that should be revived before broad interchangeable-chat work.
route_change.after: Treat Worker Fabric as a behavioral lineage already materially merged into the current universal-worker kernel/allocator/lifecycle. Historical mechanisms may donate only proven missing clauses/components after provenance recovery and differential comparison.

verified_current_descendants.evidence: Binding canary model defines identical bootstrap, role-fluid workers, generator/evaluator/promoter separation, claim protection, local integration, recovery and durable RETURN/re-entry.
Current candidate kernel encodes roles, wake lifecycle, CREATE_IF_ABSENT_EXCLUSIVE allocation, collision rejection, bounded authority and concrete implementation/test pointers.
CANDIDATE_VERIFIED receipt records 11/11 tests over exact source blobs and an explicit truth boundary that excludes broad 50-worker/production/Human Accepted/Current/Served proof.

Tested candidate allocator reuses the kernel, excludes active claims/live overlapping writers/unsafe recovery/global promotion and supports prepared, recovery, context, compact and discovery frontiers.

live_runtime_evidence.finding: During allocation this run repeatedly observed unclaimed paths become claimed between read and create; create_file then returned an existing-file/sha-required conflict. The worker treated each as a lost race and never overwrote the winner, then eventually atomically claimed this opportunity.
live_runtime_evidence.implication: Exclusive durable claims plus retry already coordinate useful work under concurrent identical-worker launch.
live_runtime_evidence.truth_ceiling: This validates a concrete claim-race behavior only; it does not prove the complete unattended swarm canary.

historical_source_debt.rule: Search/path absence is source debt, never proof of nonexistence or retirement. Do not reconstruct literal history from descendants.

behavioral_mapping.current_descendant: kernel validator + VERIFY + independent critic law

falsifications: A historical Worker Fabric name is not evidence that current reusable code exists under that name.
A stale path/tree reference is not sufficient provenance for current reuse.
A separate collector/evaluator/integrator runtime is not a prerequisite for useful concurrent /wc claim coordination; current roles/lifecycle already provide the behavioral split.
No search result does not imply retired/nonexistent historical behavior.
Passing kernel/allocator tests does not prove a broad production swarm.
direct_reuse: canonical identical bootstrap with role-fluid allocation
exclusive durable claim/CAS and preserve-first collision semantics
claim -> STARTED -> checkpoints/evidence -> RETURN -> DONE -> re-entry closure
explicit truth ceilings and no authority inference from tests/recency
append-only recovery rather than silent takeover

deduplication.reason: Modern implementation/hardening is already owned by universal kernel/allocator/runtime lanes; broader historical classification is already owned by O-SWARM-HISTORICAL-WORKER-MECHANISMS-V1. A new lane would duplicate active work.
deduplication.future_trigger: Only after exact historical bytes are recovered and a differential audit demonstrates behavior missing from the current descendant should a donor patch/test opportunity be opened.

truth_boundary: This return is scoped archaeology evidence. It establishes a verified current behavioral descendant and source debt from the evidence inspected; it does not classify every historical Worker Fabric artifact, prove direct code lineage, prove all provider adapters absent from all history, or promote any artifact to Current/Human Accepted/Served.
